description_en: Predicts the usage data of the current month
description_zh: 调用DescribeCdnUserBillPrediction预测用户当月的用量数据
kebab_example: aliyun cdn describe-cdn-user-bill-prediction --start-time 2018-09-30T16:00:00Z --end-time 2018-10-25T10:00:00Z --dimension flow --area CN,OverSeas --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCdnUserBillPrediction

parameters.help_en: The start time. Default value: 00:00:00 on the first day of the month. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 默认为月初第一天的零点整, 日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time. Default value: the current time. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
默认为当前时间, 日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The dimension for the billing type. A value of flow indicates data transfer and bandwidth
parameters.help_zh: 获取计费类型的维度，flow表示流量带宽
parameters.name: dimension

parameters.help_en:
The billing region. Valid values:

CN: the Chinese mainland.
OverSeas: global (excluding the Chinese mainland).
AP1: Asia Pacific 1.
AP2: Asia Pacific 2.
AP3: Asia Pacific 3.
NA: North America.
SA: South America.
EU: Europe.
MEAA: Middle East and Africa.

The default value is determined by the current billing method of the user. If the billing method is divided into regions outside the Chinese mainland, the default value is CN and OverSeas. Otherwise, the default value is CN, AP1, AP2, AP3, NA, SA, EU, or MEAA.

For more information about the countries and regions included in each area, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/142221.html
parameters.help_zh:
计费大区。取值：

CN：中国内地。
OverSeas：全球（不包含中国内地）。
AP1：亚太1区。
AP2：亚太2区。
AP3：亚太3区。
NA：北美。
SA：南美。
EU：欧洲。
MEAA：中东、非洲。

默认按用户当前计费模式决定，如果是海外分大区则为CN，OverSeas，否则为CN，AP1，AP2，AP3，NA，SA，EU或MEAA。

各区域包含的具体国家地区，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/142221.html
parameters.name: area

BillType.description_en:
The billing type of the user.

A value with the _overseas suffix indicates that the metering method is not divided into regions outside the Chinese mainland. For example, if the value is "BillType": "month_avg_day_bandwidth_overseas", it indicates that the metering method is monthly average daily peak bandwidth without region division outside the Chinese mainland.

Valid values:

hour_flow: billed by hourly data transfer.
day_bandwidth: billed by daily bandwidth.
month_95: billed by monthly 95th percentile bandwidth.
month_avg_day_bandwidth: billed by monthly average daily peak bandwidth.
month_4th_day_bandwidth: billed by monthly fourth-day peak bandwidth.
month_avg_day_95: billed by monthly average daily 95th percentile bandwidth.
month_95_night_half: billed by nighttime half-price 95th percentile bandwidth.
hour_vas: billed by hourly value-added services.
day_count: billed by daily requests
BillType.description_zh:
用户计费类型。

带_overseas后缀表示海外不分大区计费，例如： "BillType": "month_avg_day_bandwidth_overseas" 则表明该计费方式为月均日峰值海外不分区计费。

计费模式取值如下所示：

hour_flow：按小时流量计费。
day_bandwidth：按日带宽计费。
month_95：按月95峰值带宽计费。
month_avg_day_bandwidth：按月均日峰值带宽计费。
month_4th_day_bandwidth：按月第四日峰值带宽计费。
month_avg_day_95：按月均日95峰值带宽计费。
month_95_night_half： 按夜间半价95峰值带宽计费。
hour_vas：按小时增值服务计费。
day_count：按日请求次数计费

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the prediction. The time is in the ISO 8601 format and in UTC
EndTime.description_zh: 预测结束时间。时间格式为 ISO 8601，使用 UTC 时间

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the prediction. The time is in the ISO 8601 format and in UTC
StartTime.description_zh: 预测开始时间。时间格式为 ISO 8601，使用 UTC 时间
